skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze various stages of Vietnam's economic development throughout history and assess its economic potential.
Analyze the process of forming the foundations of the market economy in Vietnam.
Analyze the current state of resource development in Vietnam.
Analyze the operation of the Vietnamese economy and the development status of certain industries and sectors.
Evaluate the position and economic potential of Vietnam.
Develop skills for collecting, analyzing, and reporting economic data.
Develop independent research skills and teamwork abilities.
Develop presentation skills to convey knowledge through writing, discussion, and presentations on Vietnamese economic issues.
Enhance self-learning and research abilities related to Vietnamese economic issues.
Enhance critical thinking skills to deeply analyze issues in the Vietnamese economy.
Enhance awareness, responsibility, and professional ethics when making personal judgments and evaluations about Vietnamese economic issues.
